messages:
sara: noticing a spike of 502/egress failures from ap-ne1, a bunch of provisioning jobs stuck pulling images. hitting <https://status.cloudvendor.example/incident/3456|cloud vendor incident page>

devon: cloud vendor updated — NAT Gateway SNAT port exhaustion in ap-ne1. they say it's intermittent, working on mitigation.

lia: confirmed in our logs: container pull timeouts and KMS calls to decrypt secrets are timing out after several retries. gpu nodes come up but init fails because they can't reach registry / kms endpoints.

matt: ops-bot showed autoscaler still creating nodes but kubelet never finishes bootstrap. we should prevent more nodes from launching to avoid waste. can we pause cluster-autoscaler?

infra-bot: automated action taken: paused cluster-autoscaler for ap-ne1 at 19:06 UTC to stop further node churn.

devon: temporary workaround plan: provision small NAT instances (t3.medium NAT instances with iptables MASQUERADE) in a private subnet, update route table to point to them until vendor fixes NAT gateway. quick script below we used in earlier test envs:

```
# example NAT instance iptables (run as root)
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```

lia: also recommend switching image pulls to our cached registry mirror in eu1 for critical jobs and use cached KMS envelope keys (rotate/expire after fix). we'll add a lightweight cache-proxy to reduce SNAT pressure.

matt: spun up 3 NAT instances and updated route table for worker-subnet-3. egress improved for a subset of nodes. rolling image-pull backoff reduced immediate failures.

kevin: note on cost — running these NAT instances + cross-region egress for some fallbacks will increase spend. ballpark incremental cost ~ $80/hr while active. tagging all resources with incident-1923456789 for chargeback.

devon: we've also started diverting new training jobs to eu-central reserved pool to prevent queue blowup. this will increase latency and inter-region traffic for checkpoint pushes, but keeps SLAs for customers.

lia: still seeing occasional KMS decrypt timeouts — maybe vendor's control plane for endpoints is part of the blast radius. opened support ticket ID 987654 with vendor.

matt: monitoring shows error-rate in ap-ne1 API requests dropped from 18% -> 4% after NAT instance failover. but we should plan cleanup: revert route tables and terminate NAT instances when vendor confirms stable.

finance: noted cost impact, please update shared doc with exact uptime of the temporary fleet and we will include in incident billing.

sara: for postmortem: capture root cause (SNAT exhaustion vs vendor control-plane), our mitigation timeline, and two follow-ups: 1) implement permanent SNAT autoscaling (pool-based ephemeral NAT instances) 2) add regional registry mirrors + KMS cache layer. tagging @oncall for write-up. :memo: :hammer:

infra-bot: incident state -> mitigated (partial) at 19:12 UTC, monitoring. will auto-close when vendor marks incident resolved.
